_comment: §6.3 MCP wiring for PoMiniGames. Each entry activates a Model Context Protocol server that the agent can call at runtime. The local stdio servers (Claude Code, Playwright, Chrome DevTools, Excalidraw) are required by the constitution; the npx-based servers are pulled on demand.

claude-code._comment: Global Claude Code CLI already on PATH; the agent invokes it via the run_in_terminal tool. Listed here for registry parity with the spec.

excalidraw._comment: Excalidraw Diagram Skill — there is no first-party MCP server at the time of writing; the skill is invoked through Claude Code's tool bridge. Listed here for spec parity.

skillRegistries._comment: §6.3 spec-required global skill registries. These are pulled in by Claude Code's skill-loader; the URLs are kept in this file so the agent has a single source of truth for 'where do global skills come from'.
